item.title: Are teen girls the answer to shortage of public works workers?
item.description: Public works jobs across the country are mostly done by men. In Georgia, teenage girls are now trying out those jobs.

item.title: Who is Jim Jordan, the House Republicans' pick for minority leader?
item.description: As House Republicans prepare for life in the minority, they're turning to Jim Jordan as their next leader. In Jordan, they've picked a conservative firebrand and one of Trump's most vocal defenders.

item.title: A cafe in Ukraine relocates from its besieged hometown and reopens
item.description: After Russian airstrikes destroyed a popular cafe in a frontline Ukrainian city, the cafe reopened in a safer region, an example of how Ukrainian businesses are trying to survive amid repeated bombing.
